business_summary: Damon Technology Group Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, manufacture, sale, and service of intelligent logistics systems, key equipment, and core components in China and internationally. The company offers carton, pallet, vertical, overhead, belt, and pulley conveyor series; and flash, cross belt, sliding shoe, swivel wheel, multi-belt, split tray, and swing arm sorters, as well as electrical roller transfer and skewed wheel diverter machines. It also provides high-density storage and pick up systems, such as multi shuttle cartons and pallets, robot mini-load, i-cube, autonomous mobile robots, and carton warehouse robot systems; and software, such as warehouse management and control software, inventory management system, sort directory system, AGVS scheduling system, supervisory control and data acquisition system, and PHEGDA system. In addition, the company offers e-commerce, express delivery, supermarkets, fashion, intelligent manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals solutions. Further, it engages in the manufacture of conveying equipment and components, electric drive products, logistics equipment, instrumentation, and electrical machinery and equipment, as well as computer, communication, and other equipment; technology promotion and application services; and professional and technical services. The company exports its products. Damon Technology Group Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Huzhou, China.
